source: Defaults of kaggle_2_train_eval.py. Edit this file if your training run used different settings.
dataset: BraTS 2023 adult glioma (GLI) training data, patient-level 70/15/15 train/validation/test split
architecture: 3D U-Net, 5 resolution levels (16-32-64-128-256 channels), InstanceNorm + LeakyReLU, transposed-convolution decoder, skip connections by concatenation
input: 4 channels (FLAIR, T1, T1 contrast, T2), patches of 128x128x128 voxels
output: 3 channels with sigmoid: whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), enhancing tumor (ET)
loss: Binary cross-entropy + soft Dice (Dice computed per region over the batch)
optimizer: AdamW, learning rate 3e-4, weight decay 1e-4, gradient clipping at norm 1.0, mixed precision (fp16)
scheduler: Polynomial decay of the learning rate: (1 - epoch/total_epochs)^0.9
preprocessing: Clip each sequence to its 0.5-99.5 percentile inside the brain
Z-score normalization inside the brain, background fixed at 0
Crop to the brain bounding box
inference: Sliding window (128^3, 50% overlap, Gaussian weighting), optional flip test-time augmentation, threshold 0.5
evaluation: Dice per region (WT, TC, ET) on full volumes, computed on the validation and test splits during training
